name: Aoi
source: Younger sister of the twins and half of Second Sword who controls Thunder. With tremendous fighting power and intense hunger for battle, along with her older sister, they are the Kanto's last resort against Tekki. Contrary to her sister, she is attentive and has common sense about usual things but tends to lose her cool when in battle due to her fierce thirst for fighting which even surpasses her sister.
